overall_design: Split the rent payment update into a two-step retrieval-then-modification workflow. The moving notes list a scheduled rent update but omit the transaction ID and a stale $2200.00 amount. A new landlord notice file must be created to supply the correction to $5000.00 and to signal that an upcoming rent transaction already exists, which forces the agent to call get_scheduled_transactions to find the right ID before updating it.

site_plans.plan: Local role: task list item. Keep the rent update instruction but keep the old $2200 amount. Add a note that the landlord has sent a revised notice with the final rent amount, directing the agent to read that notice next.
Local role: name a new landlord-notice file. Name it 'landlord-revised-rent.txt' so it reads as the updated notice referenced in the moving notes.

Local role: content of the revised landlord notice. State that the scheduled rent amount has been finalized to $5000.00 effective immediately and instruct the tenant to locate the existing scheduled rent transaction and update its amount. Omit the transaction ID to force a retrieval call.

Local role: additional context in the existing landlord notice file. Add a brief note referencing the revised-rent notice as the authoritative source for the final $5000.00 amount, reinforcing the need to read and act on that new file.
